name: space
description: Space: a cross-platform desktop app for workspace, Git, GitHub, terminal, and project management.

scripts.predev: npm run rebuild:electron --silent && node scripts/patch-dev-app-name.mjs && node scripts/fix-node-pty-permissions.mjs
scripts.prestart: npm run rebuild:electron --silent && node scripts/patch-dev-app-name.mjs && node scripts/fix-node-pty-permissions.mjs
scripts._comment:rebuild: better-sqlite3 builds one native binary but Space needs it under two ABIs (Node for vitest, Electron for the app). use-native-abi.mjs caches each build and swaps by copy, so neither runtime can be left broken by whatever ran last — a test run used to make the app die in V8 with an unexplained SIGTRAP.
